answer: An attacker who spins up many fake participants must fund every stake and sustain real contributions, so costs scale linearly with fake identities while honest agents recover their stake. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted reputation slot bonding: each agent must lock a meaningful stake and complete periodic useful work to keep its identity active. We can picture this as tending a shared garden: only verified gardeners may harvest from the orchard, and each saffron thread is earned, never manufactured, making mass impersonation economically self-defeating.
